sort_facts.title.description: Sort fact: alphabetical order of the title, ignoring accents and case. One name on the Library and the Watchlist Sort & Filter panels.

sort_facts.date_added.description: Sort fact: the date the title was added (to the library, or to the Watchlist on the account).

sort_facts.release_date.description: Sort fact: the title's release date. Titles without one sort last in either direction.

sort_facts.rating.description: Sort fact: the title's score (the critics' number). The one word for it on every page, the same as the Under posters picker's Score.

sort_facts.audience_rating.description: Sort fact: the audience's score for the title, as the Library offers it beside the critics' score.

sort_facts.last_viewed.description: Sort fact: the date the viewer last played the title (the server's lastViewedAt). One name on every Sort & Filter panel; sentence case.

sort_facts.random.description: Sort fact: a shuffled order with no ends (the server's random key). One short word; sentence case.

sort_facts.a_to_z.description: Direction word on the checked sort row when the order is alphabetical, first letter first. Shown in place of a chevron.

sort_facts.z_to_a.description: Direction word on the checked sort row when the order is alphabetical, last letter first.

sort_facts.oldest_first.description: Direction word on the checked sort row when a date order runs from the oldest date.

sort_facts.newest_first.description: Direction word on the checked sort row when a date order runs from the newest date.

sort_facts.lowest_first.description: Direction word on the checked sort row when a rating or count order runs from the lowest.

sort_facts.highest_first.description: Direction word on the checked sort row when a rating or count order runs from the highest.
